scope: R245 clarifies the native source-resolution status for Noether Papers 19 and 20 against the current R225 German base. It includes extracted current P19/P20 TeX, compact GDZ source PDFs, page/canvas maps, raw-image resolution ledgers, and prior survival/no-fix ledgers.
result: No TeX patch. P19 and P20 already survive into R225 by exact section equality from prior R216/R226 bridge checks. Known P19 tail repairs and the P20 formula (13) kappa/lambda repair remain present in R225.
quality_caveat: P19 official GDZ raw full-page images are native 400ppi. P20 official GDZ raw full-page images are mixed native 400/600ppi, and the important formula (13) page, printed p31, is native 400ppi. Older files labelled 1000dpi are enlarged known-locus witnesses only, not native 1000ppi source authority. Do not claim strict 650+ page-by-page certification for P19/P20 from these witnesses.
recommended_action: Preserve current P19/P20 R225 TeX, do not replay older P19/P20 fixes over R225, and reopen only against a concrete mismatch or a stronger native source. Keep this as source-quality/anti-regression support, not as source closure.
